title: A Four-Shell, Nesting Doll-like 3d–4f Cluster Containing 108 Metal Ions

synthesis.procedure: NaOH solution (1.00 M in water) was added to nickel(II) nitrate hexahydrate, gadolinium(III) nitrate hexahydrate, and iminodiacetic acid in 10.0 mL deionized water until incipient but permanent precipitation. The mixture was transferred to a 25 mL Parr Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel, heated to 180 °C over 200 min, held for 6000 min, cooled to 100 °C over 1000 min, held for 2000 min, and cooled to room temperature over 2000 min. Blue block-shaped crystals were obtained.

properties.summary: Magnetic susceptibility and magnetization measurements indicate overall antiferromagnetic interactions. The article also reports UV/Vis absorption wavelengths.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete 108-metal cation has four nested, approximately cubic shells: an inner Gd2Ni6 shell, followed by Gd20, Gd32, and outer Ni48 shells. Triply bridging hydroxo groups link the shells into a compact brucite-like core; iminodiacetate ligands are associated with the outer nickel framework.
